last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 4
last_episode_to_air.overview: On Eddie's birthday, the Millers try to celebrate like everything is normal. But a series of upsetting events threatens to send the family over the edge.

body.name: Adolescence
body.overview: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, the psychological expert and the detective in charge are all left asking: what really happened?
body.tagline: A child accused. Everyone left to answer.
